# Playwright CLI browser automation (Microsoft)

Control a real browser from the terminal with playwright-cli: navigate, click, fill, test.

- Source: https://github.com/microsoft/playwright-cli
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/playwright-cli/main/skills/playwright-cli/SKILL.md
- Author: Microsoft
- License: Apache-2.0
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/playwright-cli-browser-automation-microsoft-40136535

Teaches Claude to automate a browser through the playwright-cli tool instead of an MCP server, which keeps context use low. It covers opening pages, reading accessibility snapshots, clicking and filling by element reference, uploads, screenshots, tabs and sessions, and working with Playwright tests. Reference files cover advanced commands. Requires the @playwright/cli package (npm install -g @playwright/cli).

**Try asking:**
- "Open our staging site and test the login flow"
- "Fill out this web form and take a screenshot"
- "Write a Playwright test for the search page"
